messages:
zoe-sales: Quick sync for LockTree POC: they need a crisp bulleted reply that covers offline bundle contents, upgrade cadence options, rollback behavior, SBOM/licensing handoff, and a short cost estimate. Can someone drop a compact version?
matt-eng: Offline bundle = full tarball (runtime binaries, model weights, configs, install script). Installer runs fully offline; no outbound egress. Bundles are GPG-signed + sha256 checksums. We produce full bundles and delta bundles.
nina-ps: Typical cadence we propose: monthly security rollups + quarterly feature bundles. For strict customers we can do ad-hoc pushes on request. For POC recommend full bundle initial then deltas.
olga-security: We'll include SPDX SBOM and a license matrix (OpenSSL, glibc, Python deps). Recommend customer agrees to maintenance windows and provides DB snapshots beforehand.
zoe-sales: Rollback ask: they want a simple rollback story. How simple is it?
matt-eng: We provide `redwoodctl rollback --bundle <id>` to restore previous binaries and artifacts. Important caveat: DB/schema migrations can be non-reversible; always snapshot DB before upgrade. We also document smoke tests to validate post-rollback health.
billing-bot: Pricing sketch: offline packaging/signing = $3,800 one-time; remote weekend upgrade support = $11,000 flat; optional onsite engineer = $5,500/day + travel.
zoe-sales: SLA for upgrade success?
nina-ps: We can deliver a runbook, pre-check checklist, and supervise the upgrade remotely. A contractual SLA for success requires PS engagement + Dedicated environment. Otherwise we offer best-effort with rollback and acceptance tests.
olga-security: FIPS-enabled build and HSM/KMS support are available but separate: FIPS build takes ~2 weeks extra, HSM onboarding 22 weeks for validation depending on customer's HSM.
zoe-sales: Action items I'll send to LockTree: 1) SPDX SBOM + license matrix (olga) 2) signed bundle proof + verify steps (matt) 3) short upgrade runbook + rollback steps (nina) 4) ballpark quote PDF (billing) 5) FIPS/HSM timeline note (matt+olga). I'll ask for their preferred maintenance windows and whether they want onsite support. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
